title: fix(app-shell): top-bar avatar menu — Profile link to account:profile_card
body:
## Problem
The console top-right avatar menu's account entry was dead: it surfaced the hidden `account` app via a generic `navigate('/apps/account')`, but the bare app path doesn't reliably resolve to the app's first (component-type) nav item — so clicking it dead-ended.

## Fix
Add an explicit **Profile** item that navigates straight to the component route:
```
/apps/account/component/account/profile_card
```
(resolved by the `component/:ns/:name/*` route → `ComponentNavView`; matches the Account app's first nav item `account:profile_card`). Entering at the component route still mounts the Account app shell, so **Inbox / Security / Developer** stay reachable from its sidebar.

The `account` app is filtered out of the generic hidden-apps loop so there's no duplicate dead "Account" entry.

Reported on crm.objectos.app: top-right menu broken → should be a Profile link.

## Validation
`pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` → 0 errors (after building deps).

## Deploy note
To reach staging (crm.objectos.app): merge → bump cloud `.objectui-sha` → cloud deploy.
